The Hangar One Standard
“Preserving a fine automobile, aircraft or vessel is more than a service. It is the privilege of caring for a work of art in motion.”

We take pride in the work because we understand the feeling behind ownership. The engineering, craftsmanship and character of these machines deserve more than routine cleaning. They deserve patient inspection, disciplined technique and a preservation plan designed around how the asset is used, stored and enjoyed.

Preservation Services

Three disciplines. One uncompromising standard.

Each engagement is quoted after a condition review. We avoid generic packages when the condition, materials and intended outcome require a more precise recommendation.

01 • Automotive

Automotive Preservation

Preservation, Not Production

Every asset receives its own plan.

Condition, materials, storage environment, travel schedule and owner expectations all shape the correct approach. Hangar One does not force rare or highly finished assets into a generic service package.

We define the work first, communicate clearly and perform with controlled methods selected for the specific surface in front of us.

01

Private consultation

We review the asset, location, timing, condition and desired finish.

02

Condition plan

You receive a defined scope with optional enhancement and protection recommendations.

03

Precision service

Work is completed with controlled methods, premium materials and careful documentation.

04

Preservation record

Final observations and maintenance guidance help preserve the result between visits.

Priority Dispatch

When departure cannot wait.

Advance appointments are preferred and secured with payment. Subject to technician access, airport authorization and travel feasibility, last-minute aviation preparation may be accepted through Priority Dispatch. The dispatch fee is separate from the selected service and reflects schedule displacement, immediate mobilization and after-hours availability.
